title: feat(mindmaps): implement neo look
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

This PR implements the neo look for the mindmap diagram, extending the existing neo look support (already available for other diagram types) to mindmap diagram-specific rendering.

## :straight_ruler: Design Decisions

### **Neo Look for Mindmap Diagrams**
Extended neo look support to mindmap diagrams so they use the same visual style (shapes, section colors, strokes, optional gradient) as other diagram types when look: 'neo' is set.

### Mindmap Neo Look Styling
Updated mindmap styles and rendering to support neo look with:

- **data-look targeting**: Neo-specific CSS uses [data-look="neo"] on nodes and edges so section fills, strokes, and labels only change when neo look is active; classic/handDrawn are unchanged.
- **Theme-aware section colors:** Section fills, strokes, and label colors depend on theme (redux, redux-dark, neutral, neo-dark) and are driven by options (no getConfig() in style functions).
- **Gradient stroke support**: When the theme sets useGradient, neo sections use url(#svgId-gradient) for stroke; the <linearGradient> is created in rendering-util/render.ts at render time and referenced from mindmap/styles.ts.
- **Neo stroke widths**: Edge and section stroke widths are reduced for neo (e.g. Math.max(10 - (i - 1) * 2, 2)) for a cleaner look.

### **Shape Rendering**
Adjusted mindmap shape rendering for neo look:

- **Default mindmap node** (tab-like): When node.look === 'neo', the default node uses a path with rounded top corners and a flat bottom; classic look keeps the fully rounded rect.
- **Default shape by theme**: In mindmapDb, the default node shape is 'rounded' for redux-family themes and 'defaultMindmapNode' otherwise, so default mindmaps match the intended look per theme.
- **Rounded rect:** roundedRect now takes ShapeRenderOptions and uses themeVariables?.radius so theme-defined radius is applied consistently.

### Edge Markers and Attributes
Ensured edges participate in neo styling:

- **data-look on edges:** Edge SVG paths get data-look from edge.look so neo edge CSS (e.g. stroke width) applies correctly.
- **Neo-specific edge handling**: Edge drawing branches on edge.look === 'neo' for margin and styling behavior where needed.

- [ ] :book: have read the [contribution guidelines](https://mermaid.js.org/community/contributing.html)

- [ ] :notebook: have added documentation. Make sure [`MERMAID_RELEASE_VERSION`](https://mermaid.js.org/community/contributing.html#update-documentation) is used for all new features.
- [ ] :butterfly: If your PR makes a change that should be noted in one or more packages' changelogs, generate a changeset by running `pnpm changeset` and following the prompts. Changesets that add features should be `minor` and those that fix bugs should be `patch`. Please prefix changeset messages with `feat:`, `fix:`, or `chore:`.
